summary: This topic describes how transport fees are structured, often based on routes/areas and divided into installments, and emphasizes the need for detailed transport data (bus numbers, pick-up points, student assignments) for effective management within the ERP's transport module.
steps: Provide transport fee data, including area-wise charges (e.g., 24000, 28000, 32000) and their installment divisions.
Provide detailed transport data, including bus numbers, specific pick-up points, and the assignment of students to particular buses and routes.
The ERP team will then import this data into the system.
business_rules: Transport fees are typically divided into multiple installments (e.g., four parts).
Fees for transport vary based on the student's transport area or route.
important_notes: Detailed transport data, including bus numbers, pick-up points, and student divisions, is essential for the effective functioning of the transport module.
The ERP team will provide sample Excel formats to assist in preparing transport data for import.
The institution needs to create bus-wise divisions of children and routes if not already in place.
